correctness.rationale: Verified the exact probability-weighted Haar kernel and signed active-mass split: sibling mass (1-q)(z-e), retained mass qz+(1-q)e. Its Bellman functional has affine envelope A_j+B_j|z|; the small-child opposite sign dominates both alternatives at each endpoint, and convexity excludes the large-child branches. Thus U=A_1+B_1 for all positive depth-dependent product biases. For r_j<1/2 the competing endpoint gaps are strict and the active mass does not vanish, proving the rare-leaf/alternating-ancestral-sign characterization. Solving B_m=1-r-r B_(m-1) and summing A gives the stated homogeneous closed form, including d=0 and r=1/2 limits. Independently recomputed direct weighted kernel row sums on five rational probability profiles; finite arithmetic corroborates rather than proves the induction.
